analyses.outcome_group: Any emergency contraceptive pill use after advance provision
analyses.timepoint_policy: Select participant-level one-or-more emergency-contraception-use records at a source-defined cumulative follow-up from 6 through 12 months. When a randomized cohort has multiple eligible reports or timepoints, retain the earliest complete participant-level follow-up within that window.

rules: Select one complete binary record per independent randomized trial when it compares advance emergency contraceptive pill provision with standard or on-demand access and reports participants with one or more uses.
Require source-defined 6- to 12-month follow-up, event counts paired with complete group denominators, and a RR.

When multiple eligible reports arise from one randomized cohort, select the earliest complete participant-level follow-up in the allowed window; do not combine a subgroup, a secondary analysis, or a later report from that cohort.
Do not use target-review forest rows, review totals, article-specific labels, or target combined effects.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
